body:
We are not going to do it right away. For our usage, we are going to do bundles everytime.

After talking with @Jerskouille, this came up:
The use case "a `<script>` user is aware enough to be wanting to optimize the usage of his own `<script>` tags by sharing dependencies without using browserify/webpack AND he found the relevant documentation in our website" should be very rare or non-existent.

If I am wrong here I am happy to provide 🍻 to both @Jerskouille and our user if that happen.
